# Test Automation Skill

Inspect current test tools and conventions before choosing libraries. Keep tests deterministic, isolated, readable and fast. Use fixtures/builders and synthetic media. Mock only external services or nondeterminism; do not mock the behavior under test. Use contract tests for provider/API adapters, integration tests for persistence/queues/storage and E2E tests for critical user journeys. Capture logs/screenshots/artifacts on failure. Quarantine flakes with an owner and expiry; never silently ignore them.
